name: glade
description: A fantasy-themed desktop shell for Codex workflows.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k "tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --watch" "vite" "wait-on dist-electron/main/main.js tcp:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:electron
